info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Program Trading Management API
info.description: The Program Trading Management API allows users to update and manage program trading configurations within wholesale trading environments. This API supports actions such as adjusting parameters related to program trading strategies and settings. It is designed for institutional traders and trading firms looking to optimize trading executions based on changing market conditions. Typical use cases include modifying risk thresholds or updating trading algorithms to enhance performance and compliance. Leverage this API to streamline your trading operations and ensure that configurations align with your strategic objectives.
